Hi all - thanks for the ping, Marissa. Attaching the artifacts and summarizing key points below. Attachment notes: redwood-pen-test-report-2026.pdf has vendor findings; we have redacted any customer-specific data. The vuln process doc outlines our cadence and disclosure steps. (See attachments.)

Summary - key answers for ComplyCo:
- Pen test: most recent third-party external penetration test completed 2026-09-14. We are including the executive summary and redacted technical findings in the attached PDF (redwood-pen-test-report-2026.pdf).
- Vulnerability scanning cadence: internal automated scans run weekly (SAST/DAST/dep scans where applicable). External dependency scans run daily via automated tooling; we run external recon/scanning before major releases.
- External pentesting cadence: annual third-party test + targeted tests for major infra changes.
- Triage & SLA: Critical vulnerabilities (CVSS >=9 or active exploit) - initial triage and mitigation plan within 72 hours; fix or mitigations deployed within 30 days where feasible. High (7-8.9) - triage within 5 business days, remediation target 45 days. Medium/low - tracked and prioritized per product roadmap. We can provide a remediation timeline per finding if you want specifics from the 2026 report.
- Coordinated disclosure: security@redwood.com is the primary inbox; we also maintain a dedicated PGP key for sensitive reports and will handle disclosure timelines with the reporter/customer. Disclosure policy attached (Redwood-Vuln-Disclosure-Process.docx).
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type I (controls design) in 2025; Type II (operating effectiveness) audit is scheduled for Q1 2027 with expected report mid-Q2. We can share the Type I report and a controls mapping now; Type II report will be provided when available.
- HIPAA: Redwood can sign a BAA. If ComplyCo expects PHI to be processed, please confirm the data flows and we can provide additional architecture docs.

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-report-2026.pdf (pdf, executive summary + redacted findings), Redwood-Vuln-Disclosure-Process.docx (docx)
